additional_unfrozen_file_observed.reason: Author is adding explicit v1-to-R3 final configuration conversion and manifest pins; no final builder approval is implied.

checked_source_properties: Native entry requires actual UID/GID zero, parent PID one, real bootstrap SELinux context, enforcing policy, and exactly four effective/permitted capabilities.
Native entry verifies immutable-root filesystem type/flags, writable noexec state-bind flags, candidate/state inode equivalence, and all three stage views with fixed dev/ino/owner/mode/SELinux label.
The pinned interpreter is required to be a regular, single-link root-owned 0555 file; source/config/claims are pinned private 0600 files.
Owner stop is checked before intent, before chroot/exec, and again by Python before health/serve; init also has a stop-property trigger.

Python rechecks process domain/capabilities, source/config/claims and stage identity, then obtains native health through the kernel-peer-checked R6 transport before entering the daily provider in the same process.
Stage provisioning and binding use fresh identities; binding requires the existing bootstrap running and both ready properties before and after the new bind.
No DSP permission grant, original-state chmod, owner-stop removal or service start is performed by the reviewed renderers.

operational_constraints.detail: preflight_only still creates the exclusive entry and post-exec intent files for this instance/boot. It cannot be changed into a same-boot automatic serve retry.

unbind-empty-stage.sh deliberately refuses nonempty stage data. It is a pre-use rollback helper, not a complete used-instance rollback. A used instance needs the separately reviewed stopped-service/original-image/reboot rollback path while retaining request evidence.

not_established_by_static_review: Successful early init import or actual post-exec capability inheritance on the device.
Production phone_worker access to DSP devices and NPU libraries.
Real App operations or completion of a phone-control loop.
loader_layout_issue: A separate native_backend layout-r4 fix is owned by the parent/mobile_models review; this record does not qualify the old layout.
